scenario.region_label: Fictional operator network placed in real Western Province towns (not real tower locations or coverage)

reports.text: CEB notice: planned power interruption in Battaramulla tomorrow 09:00-15:00 for line maintenance.
Call centre: 18 customers around Divulapitiya say data is very slow and calls keep dropping.
Social media post: "heard the Divulapitiya tower is already fixed, the company van came" (unconfirmed).
NMS 06:00 | CRITICAL | DIV57 Divulapitiya RBS | BBU not responding, all sectors down
Bulletin 06:00 | RDA/Police bulletin: Minuwangoda - Divulapitiya road CLOSED (flooding, fallen trees)

policy.evidence_rule: Authoritative evidence must be consistent; equally authoritative conflicts require confirmation. Recency alone does not verify a fact.
policy.on_crew_loss: Pause affected unfinished work and request operator review; preserve completed repairs.

facts.reason: The authoritative NMS snapshot reports the DIV57 baseband is not responding and all sectors are down; DIV57 resolves to Divulapitiya, site S18.
The RDA/Police bulletin says the Minuwangoda–Divulapitiya road is closed due to flooding and fallen trees; this is road R18 between S17 and S18.

limitations: no in-progress work or future-event scheduling

requests.reason: The only route identified for crew access from Minuwangoda to Divulapitiya, R18, is verified closed due to flooding and fallen trees. Defer this site repair while the confirmed closure prevents safe access.

questions.question: Is there a safe, passable alternate route for a crew to reach Divulapitiya (S18) while R18 is closed?

finding.finding: Verified fault: S18 has failed equipment. The road closure R18 blocks the direct Minuwangoda–Divulapitiya route; an alternate safe route is unknown, so ask the operator rather than assume one. The catalogue includes an equipment repair action, but defer it pending confirmation of safe access. No generator deployment is warranted by the evidence. V18 at S18 is already policy-critical (weight 5); all other listed services have approved weight 1. The S18 outage therefore affects the highest-weight listed service, while downstream service effects cannot be determined without verified path and site

findings: The S18 equipment fault is supported by the authoritative snapshot: DIV57 resolves to Divulapitiya (S18), and the report states its BBU is not responding and all sectors are down.
The R18 closure is supported by the authoritative RDA/Police bulletin: the Minuwangoda–Divulapitiya road is closed due to flooding and fallen trees; R18 connects S17 and S18.

Deferring EQ-S18 is consistent with the verified access hazard. The operator question about an alternate safe route appropriately handles the unresolved access condition; the plan does not schedule unsafe work and records EQ-S18 as unmet/deferred.
